items.title: Novo Nordisk shares plunge over 7% as new targets fail to reassure investors
items.summary: Novo Nordisk (NYSE:NVO), the Danish drugmaker, saw its US-listed shares fall over 7% to $39.82 on Monday after new long-term targets failed to ease investor concerns about competition in the weight-loss drug market. items.title: What Would It Take For Pfizer To Cut Its Dividend?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) has returned 23.1% over the past year and trades about 5% below its three-year high. Yet one question keeps coming back on its earnings calls: would it ever cut the dividend? An analyst asked it outright on the August call, and another tied it to a big acquisition in May. So what would a cut take, and what would it change.
